messages:
hana: Noticed A/B divergence when branch-throttle + telemetry sampling active. B shows tail in sampled-only.

omar: Sampling seems to skip warmup traces; observer missing cold-starts.

beau: Suggest adding rollout.metadata.sample_mode and sample_seed so runtime and observer pick the same buckets.

riley: Privacy: seed must be per-tenant and rotatable. For Private installs use KMS-protected seed.

sre-bot: alert: variant_b.p95_latency > 700ms (5m) at 4312223350  acknowledged.

hana: Also propose warmup.shadow_ratio to mirror small fraction to canary for cache priming.

omar: Minimal API: PATCH /routes/{id}/rollout { metadata: sample_mode, sample_rate, seed_salt, shadow_ratio, eviction_protect_secs }. Runtime reads header X-Rollout-Bucket.

beau: Test matrix: seeded vs random sampling, shadow on/off, varying shadow_ratio. Track p95/p99, cache-miss, model-failure-rate.

riley: Ops: feature flag, per-tenant seed rotation, alert de-noise (min_samples), docs for Private KMS.

hana: Decision: proceed with seeded sampling + tiny shadow warmup + rollout metadata for warmup hints. Owner: beau. Followups: RFC + PoC.

sre-bot: Actions: beau#create-rfc, omar#validation-plan, riley#ops-runbook.
